product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Large Screen Portrait and Landscape Displays Fits 55 to 86 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Large Screen Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 55" to 86" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Large Screen Displays is designed to mount two large, landscape or portrait-oriented TVs on a single structural column. It supports 55" to 86" displays, provides adjustable tilt for viewing optimization, and enables high-impact dual-screen signage without consuming wall or floor space. This mount is suited to concourses, retail floors, and venues where two displays must share one column while remaining cleanly integrated into the architecture.Mounts two landscape or portrait-oriented displays on a single structural column for maximum screen real estateSupports 55" to 86" TVs with a maximum load capacity of 88 lbs (40 kgs) per screenCompatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mmAdjustable tilt from ‑6° to +15° for viewer-optimized display anglesIdeal for mirrored signage, side-by-side content zones, or paired displays in open commercial spacesMinimizes structural attachments while maximizing dual-screen impact in lobbies and concoursesSteel construction with included fasteners for rigidity and stabilityDesigned for indoor commercial use; professional installation recommended DUAL DISPLAY COLUMN MOUNTED DESIGNThe mount supports two landscape or portrait-oriented displays on a single structural column, allowing installers to maximize screen real estate while minimizing structural attachments. This configuration is ideal for mirrored signage, side-by-side content zones, or paired displays in open commercial spaces. DESIGNED FOR EXTRA LARGE COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSSupports 55" to 86" TVs with a maximum load capacity of 88 lb (40 kg) per screen, ensuring stable support for large-format commercial displays. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR VIEWING OPTIMIZATIONThe mounting interface provides a tilt range of ‑6° to +15°, enabling installers to optimize viewing angles based on column height and audience position. BROAD VESA COMPATIBILITYSupports VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mm, covering the majority of large commercial flat panel displays. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with included fasteners provides rigidity and stability for indoor commercial installations.
